common_conditions: Target LMCs already provisioned with location-reporting configuration
condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

conditions: Requester is LMC or MC service server
claims.conclusion: For an LMC requester, LMS checks requester authorization and target LMC's authorization to share with that requester. MC service server is implicitly trusted and need not undergo that server authorization check.

LMS acquires latest location using on-demand reporting depending on requested information, or PLMN source, then immediately reports the acquired location. Optional UE label is not sent to the MC service server.

limitations: No guaranteed positioning latency or accuracy is established.
V19.9.0 is independent of existing V19.10.1 editorial summaries; no version-equivalence claim.
Selected §10.9.3.2 acquisition behavior is now covered in report-acquisition; PLMN LCS and full protocol encoding remain unchecked.
